//: Redesign classifier config (plan-redesign §R3.10, §R4.4). The accent families come from tokens.css at the base and the head, so only the named exceptions live here. Entry shape: { "name", "reason", "baselines": ["test-visual/__screenshots__/<spec>/<file>.png"], "theme"?: "light" | "dark", "old": ["#hex"], "new": ["#hex"] }. Only the listed baselines; only the exact old→new pair (±ΔE00 1) is strong, and its anti-aliased blends count only within 2 px of such a core pixel. `noise`: per-baseline noise allowances { baseline, maxRatio, reason } above the general cap (CAPS.noiseRatio 0.25 %), each with a named cause. `pairs` ([[old, new, over?], …]) keeps each old colour with its own new one; `over` records the surface a soft-tint pair was measured over (a surface token, or a neutral native grey), and a unit test recomputes the pair from the base and head --accent-soft over it. `themes`: { theme, source, reason, baselines } sets a baseline's theme from source instead of the lightness vote, for exactly those baselines.

themes.reason: The widget window: index.html:2 pins <html data-theme="dark"> (confirmed in the Q13 review).
